read-build-and-write-an-introduction.label: Read, Build, and Write an Introduction
read-build-and-write-an-introduction.summary: Ask and answer where someone lives using Ki kote ou rete? and Mwen rete…

read-build-and-write-an-introduction-cho.title: Choose the residence question
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-cho.prompt: Which Kreyòl question asks where someone lives?
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-cho.hint: Choose the question about place of residence.

help.concept: A location question uses a fixed beginner conversational pattern.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

read-build-and-write-an-introduction-fil.title: Complete the residence sentence
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-fil.prompt: Choose the verb that completes the sentence about where a person lives.
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-fil.hint: Use the residence pattern practiced in the lesson.

help.concept: The blank needs the action associated with a person's place of residence.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

read-build-and-write-an-introduction-lis.title: Hear where someone lives
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-lis.prompt: Listen, then build the sentence you hear.
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-lis.hint: Listen for the subject, residence verb, and place.

help.concept: Build the sentence in the same order as the spoken Kreyòl.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

help.concept: Speaking practice compares the recognized transcript with the authored Kreyòl question.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

read-build-and-write-an-introduction-bui.title: Build a residence answer
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-bui.prompt: Arrange the words to say “I live in Chicago.”
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-bui.hint: Put the speaker first, then the residence pattern, then the place.

help.concept: A short location answer follows a stable word order.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

read-build-and-write-an-introduction-wri.title: Write the location question word
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-wri.prompt: Type the Kreyòl word used in the question to ask “where.”
read-build-and-write-an-introduction-wri.hint: Use the first word from the residence question.

help.concept: This question word is used to ask about a place.
help.hint_1: Use the complete pattern introduced in this lesson.
help.hint_2: Compare the choices with the sentence or audio before answering.

ask-place.title: Ki kote ou rete?
ask-place.bodyMarkdown:
A useful introduction question is:

**Ki kote ou rete?** — Where do you live?

Learn the question as one complete chunk. You will hear the same structure again in later travel and everyday-life lessons.

answer-place.title: Mwen rete…
answer-place.bodyMarkdown:
Answer with **Mwen rete…** followed by a place:

- **Mwen rete Chicago.**
- **Mwen rete Boston.**

The place changes, but the sentence pattern stays stable.

third-person-place.title: Li rete…
third-person-place.bodyMarkdown:
Use **Li rete…** to say where another person lives:

**Li rete Boston.**

This reuses the pronoun **Li** from the beginning of the module.
